purpose: Pre-survey robustness, not field validation or automatic replacement of the published 30
notes: Weight and cell/review ranges follow the research source; the lane/speed shock sizes, bounds and random scenario count are explicit analyst stress assumptions.
Random C6 1-5 scenarios assume routes are still feasible. C6=0 is tested separately by simulated exclusion; neither creates observations or changes gates.
Min-max and z-score apply to X for C5; criterion C1-C5 score normalization stays min-max per greedy round.
Quantile bins use canonical min-max ranks to prevent floating-point tie changes when only X scaling changes.
No quota or boundary perturbation: the user-fixed A10/B8/C12 design is retained.
